newsitem.title: USA: Hospitality wins $15.1 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Hospitality wins $15.1 mln in contracts.

text.p: Hospitality Worldwide Services Inc said Monday two of its subsidiaries won contracts worth $15.5 million, which should help produce record results for both units in 1997.

The company said its Hospitality Restoration and Builders subsidiary received contracts from FelCor Suite Hotels Inc and Chartwell Leisure Inc valued at $5.5 million for renovation and capital improvement work at six hotel properties.

Its Leonard Parker Co subsidiary received procurement service contracts valued at $10 million from the Fairmont Hotel, San Jose, Calif.; Lafayette Hilton, Lafayette, La.; and Radisson Daytona Beach, Daytona Beach, Fla.
Hospitality Worldwide provides interior and exterior cosmetic renovations and maintenance as well as procurement services for the hospitality industry.
